description: This file defines types and functions for handling Signal message senders and recipients, including resolving sender identities, formatting IDs, parsing allowlist entries, and checking permissions based on group policies.

methods.name: resolveSignalSender
methods.description: Resolves a sender based on optional source number or UUID, returning a SignalSender object or null.

methods.name: formatSignalSenderId
methods.description: Formats a SignalSender into a string ID.

methods.name: formatSignalSenderDisplay
methods.description: Formats a SignalSender for display purposes.

methods.name: formatSignalPairingIdLine
methods.description: Returns a string representing the sender's ID for pairing display.

methods.name: resolveSignalRecipient
methods.description: Resolves the recipient string from a SignalSender.

methods.name: resolveSignalPeerId
methods.description: Resolves the peer ID string from a SignalSender.

methods.name: normalizeSignalAllowRecipient
methods.description: Normalizes an allowlist entry into a recipient string or undefined.

methods.name: isSignalSenderAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a sender is allowed based on an allowlist.

methods.name: isSignalGroupAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a sender is allowed in a group based on group policy and allowlist.
